body: A model with this special rule improves their armour value by 1 and has a 5+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by an attack that has the Flaming Attacks special rule. In addition, a Wizard with this special rule may wear armour without penalty.
Each combat phase, during Step 1.1 of the Choose Combat

& Fight sub-phase, before issuing challenges, any model (friend or foe) that is in base contact with this model and that does not also have this special rule suffers a single Strength 4 hit with an AP of -1. This hit has the Flaming Attacks special rule.

A Hellbound model has a 6+ Ward save against any wounds suffered and gains both the Fear and Magical Attacks special rules. If the model already has the Fear special rule, it instead gains the Terror special rule. Additionally, once per game, a Hellbound model may re-roll one Scatter dice or one Artillery dice.
Note that any Hellcannon taken as a Rare choice in a Chaos Dwarf Grand Army gains this special rule.
Unless this model is fleeing or engaged in combat, once per turn a friendly model that is within its Command range may re-roll one Scatter dice or one Artillery dice.

During the Command sub-phase of their turn, this character may attempt to urge those around them into battle with a lash of their whip by making a Leadership test. If passed, a single friendly Infantry or Cavalry unit within their command range gains a +D3 modifier to their Movement characteristic (to a maximum of 10). Note that this special rule is not cumulative. In other words, using it more than once on the same unit during the same turn has no further effect.

Once per game during the Command sub-phase of their turn, this character may attempt to drive a unit they have joined to greater efforts by making a Leadership test (using their own Leadership). If this test is passed, until your next Start of Turn sub-phase this character and any unit they have joined gains the Extra Attacks (+1) and Hatred (all enemies) special rules.

During the Movement phase, up to two friendly war machines with the ‘Steam Carriage’ upgrade that are completely within this model’s rear arc and within 8" of its base at the beginning of the phase may replace their Movement characteristic with this model’s. These war machines must finish their movement completely within this model’s rear arc and within 8" of its base. Unless this model moves using the Lumbering Destruction special rule or makes a charge move, these war machines are not considered to have moved this turn.

An Iron Daemon equipped with a Skullcracker replaces the Impact Hits (D6+1) special rule with the Impact Hits (2D6+2) special rule and the Stomp Attacks (D3+1) with the Stomp Attacks (D6+1) special rule and gains the Armour Bane (1) special rule.
Demolition rockets 12-48" 4 (8) -1(-3) Armour Bane (1), Bombardment,

cumbersome-move-or-shoot-multiple-wounds.name_en: Cumbersome, Move or Shoot, Multiple Wounds (D6)
body: Notes: This weapon shoots like a stone thrower, using the ‘Bombardment’ special rule, a 3" blast
template and the Black Powder Misfire table. The Multiple Wounds (D6) special rule applies only to a single model whose base lies underneath the central hole of the blast template.
Notes: This weapon shoots like a stone thrower, using the ‘Bombardment’ special rule, a 5" blast
template and the Black Powder Misfire table. The Multiple Wounds (D3+1) special rule applies only to a single model whose base lies underneath the central hole of the blast template.

Quake: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, any unit (friend or foe) that was within 2D6" of the central hole of a blast template after scattering fired from one or more Dreadquake mortars, suffers a -1 modifier to its Movement characteristic and cannot use the Swiftstride special rule.
If an Ogre Loader is equipped with Naptha bombs, the crew of the war machine that the Ogre Loader is joined with is also equipped with Naptha bombs.

The crew of a war machine joined by an Ogre Loader gains a +1 modifier to its Movement characteristic and the Stubborn special rule. In addition, once per game, a war machine that includes an Ogre Loader may fire twice during the Shooting phase, or re-roll a single artillery dice.
Effect: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, all enemy units suffer a -1 modifier to any rolls To Hit made whilst within 9" of the caster’s model (rolls of a natural 6 are unaffected).
Effect: A single enemy unit the caster is engaged in combat with suffers D3+1 Strength 4 hits, each with an AP of -1. These hits have the Flaming Attacks special rule.

A Darkforged weapon is a hand weapon with the Flaming Attacks special rule and can be used in conjunction with the Ensorcelled Weapons special rule. In addition, after deployment but before the first turn begins, roll on the table below to determine an attribute for the weapon. The weapon has this attribute for the duration of the battle:

rows: Malignant: The bearer of this weapon gains the Hatred (all enemies) special rule.
Life Bane: This weapon gains the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

Spell-wrought: If the bearer of this weapon is a Wizard, they may apply a +1 modifier to any Casting roll they make. If the bearer of this weapon is not a Wizard, This weapon has a Strength characteristic of S+1.

body: Notes: A model armed with a Hailshot blunderbuss suffers no negative modifiers for firing at long range, for using the Multiple Shots (D3) special rule, or whilst making a Stand & Shoot charge reaction. In addition, if 10 or more models belonging to the same unit shoot at the same target with Hailshot blunderbusses, they may re-roll any rolls of a natural 1 when rolling To Wound.

rows: Armour Bane (1) Flaming Attacks Move & Shoot Quick Shot

body: A Wizard with the ‘Lore of Hashut’ special rule may discard one of their randomly generated spells as normal. When they do so, they may select instead either the signature spell of their chosen Lore of Magic, or one of the spells listed below.

Effect: This spell can only target enemy characters. However, it may target any enemy character that is within range and that the caster can draw a line of sight to, regardless of the usual rules for targeting characters, and may even target an enemy character that has joined a unit or that is engaged in combat.
The target enemy character must immediately make a Toughness test. If this test is passed, it suffers D3 Strength 2 hits, each with an AP of -. If, however, this test is
failed, it suffers D3+2 Strength 5 hits, with no armour or Regeneration saves permitted (Ward saves can be attempted as normal).
Effect: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, all enemy units suffer a -1 modifier to any rolls To Hit made whilst within 9" of the caster’s model (rolls of a natural 6 are unaffected).
Effect: A single enemy unit the caster is engaged in combat with suffers D3+1 Strength 4 hits, each with an AP of -1. These hits have the Flaming Attacks special rule.

armour-of-bazherak-the-cruel.body: The Armour of Bazherak the Cruel is a suit of full plate armour. In addition, its wearer has the Immune to Psychology and Magic Resistance (-2) special rules.

mantle-of-stone.body: 0-1 per model. The wearer of a Mantle of Stone has a +1 modifier to their Toughness characteristic, but a -1 modifier to their Initiative characteristic.

ashen-banner.body: Any enemy model that shoots at a unit carrying the Ashen Banner suffers an additional -1 To Hit modifier.

daemonic-familiar.body: Enemy models engaged in combat with the owner of a Daemonic Familiar must reduce the Ward or Regeneration value of any Ward or Regeneration save they have by 1, to a minimum of 6+.
